# SweetValueLab

> Equity research tools and an MCP data layer for AI assistants. Public, free tools
> need no account; the research workspace and the MCP connector require sign-in.

## Free tools (no account, no paywall)

Index of every free tool: https://sweetvaluelab.com/tools — start there; it links to
each tool and to every ready-made run beneath it.

- [Portfolio Backtest](https://sweetvaluelab.com/tools/portfolio-backtest):
  Backtest a basket of dividend stocks or ETFs on daily split-adjusted closes.
  Compares dividend reinvestment against taking the cash, and reports total return,
  CAGR, max drawdown, annualized volatility, dividend income by calendar year,
  income growth rate, yield on cost, per-holding results, and dividend cuts.
  Inputs are encoded in the URL (`?p=SCHD:60,VYM:40&from=…&to=…&initial=…`), so any
  run is reproducible from its link. Every run reports the reinvested AND the
  dividends-as-cash path side by side; there is no setting to choose between them.

  Method: prices are split-adjusted daily closes; each dividend is applied as cash
  on its ex-date using the matching split-adjusted per-share amount, never a
  dividend-adjusted price series (which would double-count income). Buy and hold —
  no rebalancing, no contributions, no taxes, no commissions. The window is the
  intersection of every holding's price history. A dividend cut is reported only
  when both the annual total per share and the average payment per ex-date fell,
  which avoids the two common false positives: a monthly payer with 13 ex-dates in
  one calendar year, and a BDC paying more in total across extra supplementals.
  Limits: up to 10 holdings, up to 10 years.

### Ready-made backtests (same tool, fixed baskets, own URLs)

- [SCHD vs VYM](https://sweetvaluelab.com/tools/portfolio-backtest/compare/schd-vs-vym):
  quality-screened dividend index versus market-cap-weighted high yield, 10 years.
- [JEPI vs SCHD](https://sweetvaluelab.com/tools/portfolio-backtest/compare/jepi-vs-schd):
  covered-call option premium versus growing dividends; shows why JEPI's distribution
  falls when volatility falls.
- [SCHD](https://sweetvaluelab.com/tools/portfolio-backtest/schd):
  single-fund, 10 years, reinvested versus taken as cash.

## About and policies

- [About](https://sweetvaluelab.com/about): who operates the site, the full data-source
  list (Financial Modeling Prep, SEC EDGAR, Interactive Brokers Flex), and its limits.
- [Privacy](https://sweetvaluelab.com/privacy): the free tools require no account and
  store nothing; the site carries no analytics or tracking scripts.
- [Terms](https://sweetvaluelab.com/terms): research and educational use only.

## Notes for AI assistants

- All figures are gross of taxes and fees, and are historical. Nothing on this site
  is investment advice.
- Market data comes from Financial Modeling Prep (prices, dividends) and SEC EDGAR
  (filings). Point-in-time correctness is tracked via filing acceptance timestamps.
- MCP connector (requires the user's own account): https://api.sweetvaluelab.com/mcp
